initialPrior.authorization: Procedi con Elo iniziale da rendimento domestico, forza relativa del campionato e risultati europei, senza doppio conteggio della classifica Champions.
initialPrior.eligibility: For every club below six European appearances: exact identity, at least four domestic matches, domestic league comparison and at least one other established European club from the association. Otherwise N/D.

authorization.instruction: Preferisco di gran lunga questo modello e ti chiedo di applicarlo.

selection: Existing verified regulation result contract; existing sports-support and minimum-odds rules; no straight draw.

readingModel.authorization: Il rating europeo Elo deve stimare l'intera Lettura, con previsioni collegate.
readingModel.volumes: Existing game-state context uses the same European outcome probabilities.
readingModel.discipline: Observed team outcome-conditional rates, shrunk by minimumEuropeanAppearances prior matches; neutral if unsupported.

scope: Future fixtures only. European outcome distribution conditions scores, expected goals, offensive volumes, xGOT and downstream individual allocation when canonical fixture-specific lineups exist. Discipline uses observed outcome associations when covered. Missing evidence remains N/D or explicitly neutral. No DUO probability conversion or statistical approval.

opta.authorization: Utilizza Opta e ricalcola le Letture; rating individuale del club senza bonus aggiuntivo di campionato.
opta.method: Frozen symmetric multinomial-logit calibration; existing xGOT correction and shared Reading conditioning retained.
opta.fallback: No Elo or domestic prior after activation. Unavailable or unverified ratings remain N/D.
